snippet.title: Bluey’s Quest for The Gold Pen - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Bluey’s Quest for The Gold Pen, a brand new, original story-led adventure game 💙
Featuring an all-new story written by Joe Brumm, Bluey’s Quest for The Gold Pen invites players to unlock the world behind Bluey’s drawings, as they are brought to life as the Heeler family gather around the kitchen table to draw together.
Launching 11 December 2025 exclusively on the App Store, followed by Google Play on 10 January 2026 and coming to console and PC later in 2026.
